title: In a double complex with exact rows a cycle of the row-cokernel complex lifts to a zig-zag
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $A=(A_{p,q},d,\delta)_{p,q\ge0}$ be a homological double complex of $R$-modules: $R$-modules $A_{p,q}$ ($p,q\ge0$) and $R$-linear maps $d_{p,q}:A_{p,q}\to A_{p-1,q}$ ($p\ge1$) and $\delta_{p,q}:A_{p,q}\to A_{p,q-1}$ ($q\ge1$) with $d_{p-1,q}\circ d_{p,q}=0$, $\delta_{p,q-1}\circ\delta_{p,q}=0$ and $\delta_{p-1,q}\circ d_{p,q}=d_{p,q-1}\circ\delta_{p,q}$ whenever defined; put $A_{p,q}=0$ if $p<0$ or $q<0$ and let $d_{0,q}$, $\delta_{p,0}$ and all maps out of or into a zero module be $0$. A morphism $\Phi:A\to B$ of such double complexes is a family of $R$-linear maps $\Phi_{p,q}:A_{p,q}\to B_{p,q}$ with $\Phi d=d\Phi$ and $\Phi\delta=\delta\Phi$. Let $A^{\mathrm{rt}}_q=\operatorname{Coker}(d_{1,q}:A_{1,q}\to A_{0,q})$ with projection $\pi_q:A_{0,q}\to A^{\mathrm{rt}}_q$ ($q\ge0$); since $\delta_{0,q}(\operatorname{im}d_{1,q})=d_{1,q-1}(\delta_{1,q}(A_{1,q}))\subseteq\operatorname{im}d_{1,q-1}$, the map $\delta_{0,q}$ induces $\delta^{\mathrm{rt}}_q:A^{\mathrm{rt}}_q\to A^{\mathrm{rt}}_{q-1}$ with $\delta^{\mathrm{rt}}_q\pi_q=\pi_{q-1}\delta_{0,q}$ ($q\ge1$), and $A^{\mathrm{rt}}_\bullet$ is a chain complex of $R$-modules concentrated in degrees $\ge0$ [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]; a morphism $\Phi$ induces the morphism of complexes $\Phi^{\mathrm{rt}}$ with $\Phi^{\mathrm{rt}}_q\pi_q=\pi_q\Phi_{0,q}$. Assume that every row of $A$ is exact in positive degrees: for all $q\ge0$ and $p\ge1$ the sequence $A_{p+1,q}\xrightarrow{d_{p+1,q}}A_{p,q}\xrightarrow{d_{p,q}}A_{p-1,q}$ is exact at $A_{p,q}$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Let $Z_n(A)\subseteq T_n(A)=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}A_{p,q}$ and $B_n(A)\subseteq T_n(A)$ be the modules of zig-zags and of trivial zig-zags of total degree $n$ [def-weil-pbc-double-complex-zigzag-module]. Then for every $n\ge0$ and every $x\in A_{0,n}$ such that $\pi_n(x)$ is a cycle of $A^{\mathrm{rt}}_\bullet$ (that is, $n=0$ or $\delta^{\mathrm{rt}}_n(\pi_n(x))=0$) there is a zig-zag $a\in Z_n(A)$ with $a_{0,n}=x$.
